lines.text: Chat... somebody's mailing me my own book.
Relax, BoarFan. It doesn't hurt him. It's a tickle... with attitude.
And kids: never touch one, and never build one without a grown-up who knows how. I'm a grown-up. Allegedly.
Little spools, so the wire never touches the wood.
See this little panel? It drinks up sunshine... and fills a battery inside the box.
Then the box sends out a tiny pulse. Tick... tick... tick.
Ohh. Electricity only travels in a loop. Out the wire, through whoever touches it, into the ground... and back to the box.

msgs.text: the sun says you're welcome dear
boars learn after one tickle. they never forget
